description: This file contains custom permission classes for an inventory management API built with Django REST Framework. It defines permissions for general inventory administrators and read-only access.

classes.name: IsInventoryAdminOrReadOnly
classes.description: Allows read-only access to authenticated users and write access only for inventory admins or staff/superusers.

classes.name: IsInventoryAdmin
classes.description: Allows access only to users who are inventory administrators, including staff or superusers.

methods.name: bool has_permission(self, request: Request, view: View)
methods.description: Checks whether the requesting user has permission to access the view, based on request method and user group membership.
